contracts: (The exact read selector is discovered, runs against the real service with a nonzero count, and asserts logical-ID contract use.) AND (The fixture selector is discovered and passes only when recorded inventory is nonempty.) AND (The fixture-bound selector is discovered and passes with recorded file_count <= 10000.) AND (The lifecycle selector is discovered and non-skipped, exercises the real service, and asserts logical-ID contract usage.)
selector_intents: Execute the fixture-bound selector and fail when recorded file_count exceeds 10000.
Execute the fixture-selection selector and fail when the recorded supported-content inventory is empty.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.StorageOperations_UseLogicalIdentity_Lifecycle fails when lifecycle validation bypasses logical-ID contract enforcement or accepts caller paths.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.StorageOperations_UseLogicalIdentity_Read fails when reading bypasses the local contract or relies on a caller-controlled host path.
